snippet.description:

대한민국 국군의 허리를 담당하는 예비역 중사 두 분을 모시고, 4년 군 생활의 '빛과 그림자'를 가감 없이 담았습니다. 초임 하사 시절의 눈물 나는 적응기부터, 전방 근무를 통해 사회초년생이 9천만 원이라는 거금을 모을 수 있었던 비결까지! 효자손에서 지금 바로 확인하세요.

3. 부사관을 꿈꾸는 분들에게
단순히 돈만 보고 선택하기보다는 자신의 적성이 군대라는 조직과 맞는지 깊이 고민해봐야 합니다. 하지만 결심했다면, 그 과정에서 얻는 멘탈과 경제적 기반은 사회생활의 큰 자산이 될 것입니다.

snippet.description:
#shorts 
수전증 때문에 병무청 직원도 당황했지만, 군부심 하나로 현역 입대한 신병!
하지만 수류탄 교장에서 안전핀을 뽑는 순간... 소대장님은 사로 밖으로 대피?!
취사병, 정비병까지 도전했지만 손떨림 하나로 부대를 장악해버린 역대급 군대 실화!

snippet.title: "수전증 심한데 수류탄을 던지라고요?" 소대장도 사로로 숨게 만든 역대급 공포 ㅋㅋㅋ
snippet.description:
#수전증 #군대썰 #효자손
초등학교 때부터 남들보다 손을 많이 떨었던 '수전증' 제보자의 입대기!
공익 판정도 거절하고 당당하게 현역으로 입대한 주인공에게 닥친 시련들...

snippet.title: 대대장 1호차 운전병만 누리는 '미친 특권' ㄷㄷ
snippet.description:
#shorts #효자손 

대대장님의 "나의 눈과 귀가 되어라"라는 한 마디가 불러온 나비효과! 🦋

en-US.title: Army vs. Marine Corps [The End of Ginpai] 🔒🧊
en-US.description:
#shorts

id.title: [Kisah Nyata] "Kakek, sudah kubilang ini tanah militer!!" (Akhirnya diangkut dengan truk...)
id.description:
#shorts

"Ini tanah militer, jadi kamu tidak boleh bertani di sini!" 🙅‍♂️

Suatu hari, seorang lelaki tua mulai bertani jagung di sebidang tanah kosong di sebelah pangkalan militer.

Meskipun para tentara memperingatkan bahwa ia tidak bisa melakukannya, jagung tumbuh subur tanpa mendapat jawaban kosong berupa "Oke, oke."

Akhirnya, ketika tentara—yang menurutnya memberikan dukungan sipil—dikerahkan dan 'Operasi Pembersihan Jagung' dimulai, lelaki tua itu muncul sambil memegang sabit dan memprotes dengan keras! Ia mendapat janji bahwa tanaman akan dibersihkan dalam waktu dua minggu...

Beberapa hari kemudian, lelaki tua itu muncul di depan pos penjaga dalam keadaan mabuk dan melakukan tindakan tiba-tiba!

"Jagungku!! Jagungkuuu!!"

Pada akhirnya, ia menabrakkan truk ke pos penjagaan, mengubah tembok pangkalan menjadi kekacauan total... 💥🚛

Saksikan video untuk kisah mengejutkan tentang Kakek Jagung, yang direkonstruksi dari kisah nyata!

en-US.title: [True Story] "Grandpa, I told you this is military land!!" (Eventually by truck...)
en-US.description:
#shorts

"This is military land, so you are not allowed to farm here!" 🙅‍♂️

One day, an old man began farming corn on an abandoned plot of land next to the military base.

Despite the soldiers' warnings that he couldn't do it, the corn grew vigorously with empty replies of "Okay, okay."

Eventually, when soldiers—whom he thought were providing civilian support—were deployed and the 'Corn Removal Operation' began, the old man appeared wielding a sickle and protested vehemently! He received a promise that the crops would be cleared within two weeks...

A few days later, the old man appeared in front of the guard post drunk and committed a sudden act!

"My corn!! My cornuu!!"

In the end, he drove a truck into the guard post, turning the base wall into absolute chaos... 💥🚛

Check out the video for the shocking story of the Corn Grandpa, reconstructed from a true story!

en-US.title: What have you been doing with all your seniority as a corporal?
en-US.description:
#shorts

Only 7 weeks at my assigned unit out of 21 months of military service?!

I am revealing the story of my tumultuous military life, where I couldn't even take my 100-day leave and spent all my time being dispatched to various parts of the corps.

I managed to avoid major training like winter training and guerrilla warfare, but the story of how I became an 'invisible man' whose face I didn't even know my fellow soldiers at my unit...

Is this a cushy job, or a curse?

id.title: Apa yang telah kamu lakukan dengan semua senioritasmu sebagai seorang kopral?
id.description:
#shorts

Hanya 7 minggu di unit yang ditugaskan dari 21 bulan masa dinas militer?!

Saya akan menceritakan kisah kehidupan militer saya yang penuh gejolak, di mana saya bahkan tidak bisa mengambil cuti 100 hari dan menghabiskan seluruh waktu saya dikirim ke berbagai bagian korps.

Saya berhasil menghindari pelatihan besar seperti pelatihan musim dingin dan perang gerilya, tetapi kisah bagaimana saya menjadi 'orang tak terlihat' yang wajahnya bahkan tidak saya kenal oleh rekan-rekan prajurit saya di unit...

Apakah ini pekerjaan yang nyaman, atau kutukan?

id.title: Hal-hal mengerikan yang terjadi ketika Anda melaporkan seorang sersan wanita ke Sistem Petisi Nas...
id.description:
#cerita pendek

Seorang Marinir junior yang kehilangan kunci gerbangnya.

Dilaporkan secara tidak adil atas pelanggaran disiplin, dan di atas itu, melakukan pembangkangan terhadap seorang Sersan Staf wanita.

14 malam dan 15 hari di penjara militer. Dan kemudian kisah legendaris tentang dijual ke sebuah pulau terpencil.

Akhirnya, bahkan bandingnya pun ditolak, dan dia akhirnya dipindahkan ke pos terpencil di sebuah pulau terpencil bernama Seogeomdo...

Sebuah panggilan telepon misterius diterima saat dia tiba ☎️ Apa yang sebenarnya akan terjadi di pulau itu?

Sebuah cerita 100% realistis yang pasti akan dirasakan oleh siapa pun yang pernah mengalami ketidakadilan di militer!

Jika Anda penasaran dengan apa yang terjadi selanjutnya, silakan berlangganan dan sukai! 👍

en-US.title: The horrific things that happen when you report a female sergeant to the National Petition System...
en-US.description:
#shorts

A Marine Corps junior who lost his gate key.

Unjustly reported for misconduct, and on top of that, committed insubordination against a female Staff Sergeant.

14 nights and 15 days in the brig. And then the legendary story of being sold off to a remote island.

Eventually, even his appeal was dismissed, and he ended up being transferred to an outpost on a remote island called Seogeomdo...

A mysterious phone call received the moment he arrived ☎️ What exactly will happen on the island?

A 100% realistic story that anyone who has suffered injustice in the military will absolutely relate to!

If you are curious about what happens next, please subscribe and like! 👍

1988, sebuah bencana besar terjadi karena saya gagal memberi hormat kepada kendaraan Komandan Militer (bintang 4)!

en-US.description:

1988, a major disaster that ensued because I failed to salute the Military Commander (4-star)'s vehicle!

This is a spicy military story from those days when we had to run laps in full gear all week long.

snippet.title: 4스타한테 경례 안 했다가 벌어진 대참사 ㄷㄷ (진짜 실화임)
snippet.description:
#4스타 #사령관 #군대썰 

군대에서 4스타 군사령관 차량이 지나갈 때 경례를 안 하면 어떻게 될까요? 😱
찰나의 방심으로 대대장님에게까지 불려가 일주일간 완전군장 뺑뺑이를 돌아야 했던 스펙타클한 군대 썰!
그런데 1년 뒤, 우리를 굴렸던 그 밉상 운전관(중사)을 보급품 창고에서 다시 만나게 되는데... 과연 통쾌한 복수에 성공했을까요?

내 청소 중 스쳐 지나간 4스타 차량! "설마 보겠어?" 하고 경례를 생략했다가 분노한 운전관에게 딱 걸려버린 사연입니다.
군필자라면 공감 100%! 미필자라면 군대의 매운맛을 느낄 수 있는 오늘의 썰, 끝까지 시청해 주시고 구독과 좋아요, 알림설정 부탁드립니다! 🔥

여러분은 군대에서 별(장군) 달린 차 본 적 있으신가요? 댓글로 여러분의 썰도 남겨주세요!

[타임라인 (챕터 분할)] - 시청 유지율을 높이는 핵심 요소
08:20 🌟 오늘의 레전드 썰 제보자 소개 (1988년 군번)

11:39 🤬 급정거하는 사령관 차, 그리고 분노한 운전관(중사)의 하차
12:39 💥 중대 상황실 발칵! 대대장님의 극대노와 싸대기(?)
15:50 🎒 일주일간의 지옥.. 밥도 못 먹고 완전군장 뺑뺑이
18:19 ⏳ 반전 시작! 1년 뒤, 내 앞에 나타난 그 '밉상 운전관'
19:07 😎 보급병의 소심하지만 찌질한(?) 복수 성공 스토리

en-US.title: The huge disaster that happened because I didn't salute a 4-star general (This is a true story)
en-US.description:
#4Star #Commander #MilitaryStory

What happens in the military if you don't salute when a 4-star military commander's vehicle passes by? 😱

A spectacular military story about how a moment of carelessness led to being summoned by the Battalion Commander and forced to run laps in full combat gear for a week!

However, a year later, we encountered that hateful driver (Sergeant) who used to put us through the wringer again at the supply depot... Did we succeed in our satisfying revenge?

A 4-star vehicle brushed past me while I was cleaning! Thinking, "Surely they won't see it?", I skipped the salute, only to get caught red-handed by the enraged driver.

100% relatable for those who have served! For those who haven't, today's story lets you taste the harsh realities of the military. Please watch until the end, and don't forget to subscribe, like, and turn on notifications! 🔥

Have you ever seen a car with a star (General) on it while in the military? Please share your stories in the comments!

[Timeline (Chapter Split)] - Key Factors to Increase Viewer Retention

09:20 🧹 The Beginning of the Incident: Bitter Cold Weather, Road Cleaning Operation

10:39 🚙 The Appearance of the Infamous 4-Star Vehicle! "Surely they won't see this?"

11:39 🤬 The Commander's Car Stops Suddenly, and the Enraged Driver (Sergeant) Gets Out

12:39 💥 Company Situation Room in Uproar! The Battalion Commander's Extreme Fury and a Slap(?)

15:50 🎒 A Week of Hell... No Food, Running in Full Gear

18:19 ⏳ The Twist Begins! One year later, that 'hateful driver' appeared before me

19:07 😎 The supply soldier's timid but pathetic(?) revenge success story

20:36 🎖️ Wrap-up: I still get PTSD whenever I see 4-star generals...

snippet.title: 4년 만에 9천만 원 모았지만 '절대' 재입대 안 하는 이유? 💸 예비역 중사가 말하는 진짜 부사관 현실 (월급, 연애, 장단점)
snippet.description:
#군대 #부사관 #입대 

부사관 지원을 고민 중이신가요? 혹은 군대 안의 진짜 삶이 궁금하신가요?
대한민국 국군의 허리를 담당하는 예비역 중사 두 분을 모시고, 4년 군 생활의 '빛과 그림자'를 가감 없이 담았습니다. 초임 하사 시절의 눈물 나는 적응기부터, 전방 근무를 통해 사회초년생이 9천만 원이라는 거금을 모을 수 있었던 비결까지! 효자손에서 지금 바로 확인하세요.

⏱️ 타임라인 (주요 장면)
00:35 대한민국 국군의 중심, 부사관 인터뷰 시작
00:47 [게스트 소개 1] 방공 특기, 예비역 중사 박미진
00:58 [게스트 소개 2] 1사단 GOP 보병 특기, 예비역 중사 김준규
01:38 다시 입대한다면 부사관으로 간다 vs 안 간다? (단호한 OX 결과)
10:21 퇴근했는데 다시 나오라고? 초임 하사 시절 겪은 황당한 호출
12:59 군대에서도 사랑이? 병사에게 받은 고백 편지 에피소드
13:21 군대라는 조직의 특수성: 폐쇄적인 문화와 그로 인한 답답함
16:14 부사관 월급의 진실: 초과 근무 수당을 포함한 실제 수령액
17:18 4년 복무 후 전역할 때 8,000~9,000만 원을 모을 수 있었던 이유
18:59 [장점] 이른 나이에 안정적인 직장과 목돈 마련의 기회
19:41 [장점] 결혼 시 주거 고민 해결! 관사 제공 혜택
21:20 [장점] 어떤 사회 생활도 견뎌낼 수 있는 강력한 '강철 멘탈' 장착
26:37 지금 이 순간에도 고생하고 있을 후배 부사관들에게 전하는 응원
26:45 예비 부사관 지원자들을 위한 진심 어린 현실 조언

1. "돈 모으기에는 최고?" 부사관 월급의 현실
일반적인 생각보다 부사관의 실수령액은 높을 수 있습니다. 전방 진지 근무나 GOP 근무 시 초과 근무 수당이 더해지면 사회초년생으로서는 꽤 큰 금액인 월 250~300만 원 수준까지 수령이 가능합니다. 덕분에 4년 복무 후 약 9천만 원에 가까운 목돈을 들고 전역하는 사례도 확인했습니다.

2. 군대에서만 겪을 수 있는 특별한 경험
여군이 드문 방공 병과에서 겪은 병사들의 귀여운 고백 썰부터, 계급 사회 특유의 부조리했던 경험까지 군대 안의 인간관계를 생생하게 담았습니다.

3. 부사관을 꿈꾸는 분들에게
단순히 돈만 보고 선택하기보다는 자신의 적성이 군대라는 조직과 맞는지 깊이 고민해봐야 합니다. 하지만 결심했다면, 그 과정에서 얻는 멘탈과 경제적 기반은 사회생활의 큰 자산이 될 것입니다.

en-US.title: Why I Saved 90 Million Won in 4 Years but 'Absolutely' Won't Re-enlist? 💸 The Real Reality of Bei...
en-US.description:
#Military #NCO #Enlistment

Are you considering applying to become an NCO? Or are you curious about the real life inside the military?

We invited two reserve sergeants, who form the backbone of the Republic of Korea Armed Forces, to share the "light and shadow" of their four years of military service without reservation. From the tearful adjustment period during their early days as sergeants to the secret behind how a civilian was able to save a substantial sum of 90 million won through frontline duty! Check it out right now on Hyojason.

⏱️ Timeline (Highlights)

00:35 The heart of the Republic of Korea Armed Forces, NCO interview begins

00:47 [Guest Introduction 1] Air Defense Specialty, Reserve Sergeant Park Mi-jin

00:58 [Guest Introduction 2] 1st Division GOP Infantry Specialty, Reserve Sergeant Kim Jun-kyu

01:38 If you were to enlist again, would you go as an NCO vs. not? (Firm OX results)

10:21 You got off work, and now you're telling me to come back in? An absurd summons I experienced during my days as a junior sergeant

12:59 Love in the military? An episode about a confession letter received from a soldier

13:21 The unique nature of the military organization: The closed culture and the resulting stifling feeling

16:14 The truth about NCO salaries: Actual amount received including overtime pay

17:18 The reason I was able to save 80 to 90 million won by the time I was discharged after 4 years of service

18:59 [Advantages] A stable job and the opportunity to accumulate a lump sum at an early age

19:41 [Advantages] Housing worries solved upon marriage! Benefits of providing official housing

21:20 [Advantages] Equipped with a strong 'steel mentality' to endure any social life

26:37 Encouragement for junior NCOs who are struggling right now

26:45 Sincere and realistic advice for prospective NCO applicants

1. "The best for saving money?" The reality of NCO salaries

The actual take-home pay for NCOs can be higher than generally thought. When overtime pay is added for duty at forward positions or GOPs, it is possible to receive up to 2.5 to 3 million won per month—a substantial amount for a newcomer to the workforce. Thanks to this, we have confirmed cases where soldiers were discharged after four years of service with a lump sum of nearly 90 million won.

2. Special Experiences You Can Only Have in the Military

We have vividly captured the human relationships within the military, ranging from cute confession stories from soldiers in the Air Defense branch, where female soldiers are rare, to experiences of the absurdities unique to a hierarchical society.

3. To Those Dreaming of Becoming a Non-Commissioned Officer

Rather than choosing this path solely for the money, you must deeply consider whether your aptitude aligns with the military organization. However, if you have made the decision, the mental fortitude and financial foundation gained during the process will become significant assets for your civilian life. #NonCommissionedOfficer #CareerSoldier #NCOSalary #GOP #AirDefense #Infantry #MilitaryStories #BackScracker #Sergeant #StaffSergeant #Discharge #SavingMoney #Investment #MilitaryDating #FemaleSoldier #MaleSoldier #MilitaryReality

1. "돈 모으기에는 최고?" 부사관 월급의 현실
일반적인 생각보다 부사관의 실수령액은 높을 수 있습니다. 전방 진지 근무나 GOP 근무 시 초과 근무 수당이 더해지면 사회초년생으로서는 꽤 큰 금액인 월 250~300만 원 수준까지 수령이 가능합니다. 덕분에 4년 복무 후 약 9천만 원에 가까운 목돈을 들고 전역하는 사례도 확인했습니다.

2. 군대에서만 겪을 수 있는 특별한 경험
여군이 드문 방공 병과에서 겪은 병사들의 귀여운 고백 썰부터, 계급 사회 특유의 부조리했던 경험까지 군대 안의 인간관계를 생생하게 담았습니다.

3. 부사관을 꿈꾸는 분들에게
단순히 돈만 보고 선택하기보다는 자신의 적성이 군대라는 조직과 맞는지 깊이 고민해봐야 합니다. 하지만 결심했다면, 그 과정에서 얻는 멘탈과 경제적 기반은 사회생활의 큰 자산이 될 것입니다.

en-US.title: Faced with forced discharge from boot camp due to assault... But the company commander's reaction...
en-US.description:
#MilitaryStories #PublicServiceStories #BackScracker

Life in boot camp is tough enough, and you're insulting my parents? 🤬

The story of how the oldest fellow trainee I met at the public service training camp crossed the line with his abusive remarks about my parents, eventually leading to a fistfight!

Just before my forced discharge, a single phone call to my father turned the situation around 180 degrees.

What if my uncle, a Colonel from the Korea Military Academy, and my brother-in-law, a Sergeant Major and Company Sergeant Major, were to step in? Lol

Here comes another 100% true, no-nonsense, satisfying "tough love" story!

Military story submissions are always welcome! Subscribing and liking gives me great strength. 🫡

🕒 Timeline (Chapter Feature)

00:00 "Hey, shut up, your mom..." (Crossing the line with abusive language)

Seorang Sersan Mayor yang tidak tahu apa-apa melontarkan hinaan kepada seorang prajurit yang dengan putus asa memohon untuk berada di sisi kakeknya di saat-saat terakhirnya, dengan mengatakan, "Apakah dia meninggal? Hubungi saya ketika dia meninggal"... 🤬

Namun situasinya berubah! Teman ayah prajurit itu ternyata adalah seorang 'Letnan Jenderal Bintang Tiga'?! 🎖️

Dia akhirnya mengakui seluruh kebenaran kepada Jenderal Bintang Tiga yang mengunjungi pemakaman...

Nasib Sersan Mayor yang tidak bisa sadar dan terus berteriak pada prajurit itu sampai akhir,

Tonton videonya sekarang juga!

#KisahMiliter #SersanMayor #GuruTegas #Memuaskan #BintangTiga #Prajurit #Kematian #KisahNyata #VideoPendekYouTube #KehidupanMiliter

en-US.title: [The War of Connections] What Happens If Your Dad's Friend Is a Three-Star Star (Shudder)
en-US.description:
#shorts

A clueless Sergeant Major hurls insults at a soldier who is desperately pleading to be by his grandfather's side during his final moments, saying, "Did he pass away? Call me when he passes away"... 🤬

But the situation takes a turn! The soldier's father's friend turns out to be a 'Three-Star (Lieutenant General)'?! 🎖️

He ends up confessing the whole truth to the Three-Star General who visited the funeral...

The fate of the Sergeant Major who couldn't come to his senses and kept yelling at the soldier until the very end,

Check out the video right now!

#MilitaryStory #SergeantMajor #ToughTeacherTeacher #Satisfying #ThreeStar #Soldier #Deaths #TrueStory #YouTubeShorts #MilitaryLife

snippet.title: "니가 뭔데?? 병가를 20일이나 나가!!" 소리치던 포대장의 최후 ㄷㄷ
snippet.description:
#shorts
군대에서 주말 체육 활동 중 불의의 사고로 전방십자인대가 파열되었습니다.
단순한 부상인 줄 알았지만, 정밀 검사 결과는 생각보다 심각했습니다.
부대 간부의 불신과 차가운 시선 속에서도 묵묵히 치료와 절차를 밟아 결국 '상병' 계급으로 의병 전역을 하게 된 실제 이야기를 재구성했습니다.
군대에서 다치면 몸도 마음도 고생이라는 말, 정말 공감되네요.
비슷한 경험이 있으신 분들은 댓글로 소통해 주세요!

en-US.title: The fate of the battery commander who shouted, "Who do you think you are?? Taking 20 days of sick...
en-US.description:
#shorts

I ruptured my anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) due to an unexpected accident during a weekend sports activity in the military.

I thought it was a minor injury, but the results of the detailed examination were more serious than I expected.

I have reconstructed a true story about how, despite the distrust and cold stares of my unit's officers, I silently went through the treatment and procedures, eventually receiving a medical discharge with the rank of 'Corporal'.

I really relate to the saying that getting injured in the military causes suffering for both body and mind.

If you have had a similar experience, please share it in the comments!

[Timeline]

00:00 Conflict with the Battery Commander Begins

00:15 Sudden Injury During Soccer

00:30 Detailed Diagnosis at Civilian Hospital (ACL Rupture)

01:00 Surgical Recommendation and Unit's Reaction

01:20 Medical Examination at Capital Hospital and Passed

01:40 Medical Discharge with the Rank of 'Corporal'

id.title: Perlawanan terakhir Angkatan Udara di mana mereka menjual seluruh Unit ke-707 karena takut.
id.description:
#shorts

"Unit 707 akan datang mulai besok. Jika kita kebobolan, ya... kalian tahu maksudku, kan?"

Pasukan Khusus 707 yang menakutkan yang dihadapi selama Pelatihan Pertahanan Pangkalan Malam ORI Angkatan Udara!

Di bawah tekanan dikirim ke pelatihan disiplin militer begitu tanda nama mereka disobek,

Jasun dan rekan-rekannya akhirnya melewati batas yang seharusnya tidak mereka lewati...

Situasi absurd dan tragikomik di mana jet tempur unit tersebut dihancurkan oleh satu kata sandi!

Tonton videonya untuk melihat reuni dengan anggota 707, di mana Anda tidak boleh lengah sampai akhir!

[Timeline (Timestamps)]

00:00 Awal Pelatihan Pertahanan Pangkalan Malam ORI (Peringatan 707)

00:07 Pelatihan disiplin militer jika tanda nama Anda diambil? Para Prajurit Gemetar Ketakutan

00:13 Kesepakatan Berbahaya dengan Anggota Pasukan Khusus 707: "Beri Tahu Kata Sandinya"

00:24 Dilema Terbesar dalam Hidupku: Menjual Kata Sandi atau Tidak

00:31 Infiltrasi Landasan Pacu 707 dan Ledakan Jet Tempur yang Berakhir

00:40 "Aku Tidak Melihat Bayangan!" Adegan Laporan yang Memalukan

00:54 Pria yang Kutemui Lagi di Bus Kombi... (Datang untuk Mencari Kacamata Hitam)

en-US.title: Training ended 5 hours early due to the 707 Special Forces Unit... An epic deal that blew up(?) t...
en-US.description:
Back when I was in the Air Force Military Police, there was the hellish ORI (Operational Readiness Inspection) training that happens once every two years...

And of all things, the opposing force was the 'Army's Elite 707th Unit.' *Shudder*

It was a desperate moment where having my name tag ripped off meant being sent to military disciplinary training,

but then the 707 agents proposed a secret deal!

"Tell us the password, and we'll give you your name tag back."

In the end, I handed over the password, and as a result, all the fighter jets in the wing were blown up(?)

And the training ended five hours early—a catastrophe (or maybe a total sweet deal?)...

Check out this legendary military episode from that day—funny yet bittersweet—right now!

en-US.title: [War of Connections - Legend] The Sergeant Major Who Blocked Leave for His Grandfather's Deathbed...
en-US.description:
#MilitaryStory #CompanySergeantMajor #TeachingMeasures

A soldier requesting leave to be with his grandfather during his final moments, just as he was about to be promoted to Sergeant. However, the Company Sergeant Major hurled all sorts of insults at him, saying things like, "He hasn't passed away yet, has he?" and "You're bothering me by calling on the weekend." While the funeral was underway after many twists and turns, the Corps Commander—a three-star general and acquaintance of the soldier's father—visited the unit.

Even after the Corps Commander personally visited the unit to see the soldier, the Company Sergeant Major continued his abusive behavior, telling him, "Where are you going to hide away? Go clean the smoking area." Eventually, the Company Sergeant Major faced the Corps Commander, his face turning pale as he spouted lies, only to receive a proper lesson in the process...

Please watch until the end of this video, which demonstrates the true "power of connections" and "justice served"!

snippet.title: 3스타 군단장 조리병 생활 '지옥' VS '천국'
snippet.description:
#shorts #군단장 #조리병 

간부식당병에서 한순간에 군단장님 공관병(조리병)으로 발탁된 일병의 리얼한 군 생활 이야기!

육체적·정신적으로 탈탈 털리던 어느 날, 오찬에 참석한 한 귀빈에게 뜻밖의 제안을 받게 되는데?!

[타임라인]
00:00 쥐 한 마리로 시작된 운명적인 만남
00:10 군단장 공관병 입성! (꿀보직인 줄 알았지...)
00:17 군단장 조리병의 숨 막히는 하루 일과 공개
00:24 광기의 '웃음 치료' 시간
00:48 갑자기 분위기 바비큐 파티 (코스 요리 10인분?!)
01:01 정체불명의 대표님께 받은 의문의 명함 한 장

입대 전 마지막 자유를 만끽하러 떠난 일본 여행! ✈️
하지만 오사카에서 도쿄, 홋카이도까지 휩쓴 역대급 태풍 '하기비스'...
비행기는 결항되고, 숙소도 돈도 떨어져가는 절망적인 상황!

"저... 입대해야 하는데 한국을 못 가요..." 😭
과연 병무청의 답변은? 그리고 이들의 운명은 어떻게 될까요?

en-US.title: I have two days left before enlisting, but I'm stuck in Japan... Is this a desertion situation? 😱
en-US.description:
#short

A trip to Japan to enjoy my last bit of freedom before enlisting! ✈️

But then came the record-breaking Typhoon Hagibis, which swept from Osaka to Tokyo and Hokkaido...

Flights were canceled, and I was in a desperate situation with my accommodation and money running out!

"Um... I have to enlist, but I can't go back to Korea..." 😭

What will be the response from the Military Manpower Administration? And what will become of their fate?

#JapanTrip #MilitaryEnlistment #TyphoonHagibis #MAD #EnlistmentPrep #TravelStory #TrueStory

snippet.title: 고문관의 이병생활 [폐급편]
snippet.description:
#shorts #이등병 #그린캠프 

"군대에 꼭 한 명씩 있다는 그 전설의 고문관...!"
기상부터 취침까지, 선임과 간부의 인내심을 테스트하는 이병의 하루를 담았습니다.
과연 이 이병의 군생활은 무사할 수 있을까요? 재미있게 보셨다면 구독과 좋아요 부탁드립니다!

[타임라인 (SEO 핵심)]
00:00 인트로: 고문관의 이병생활 시작
00:01 06:00 내 마음대로 기상 및 모포 개기
00:10 06:20 아침 구보 (군가가 뭐죠? 먹는 건가요?)
00:13 07:20 아침 식사, 선임들 기다리게 하기 전문
00:20 08:30 근무지에서 즐기는 로맨스 소설과 맥심 커피
00:28 10:00 간부님께 커피 대접하는 병장 그걸 지켜만 보고 있는 이등병
00:32 11:40 점심시간 20분 전 빛의 속도로 탈출
00:36 12:30 선임의 훈계? 응~ 다음 소원수리~
00:42 17:30 저녁은 PX 냉동
00:46 18:30 전 부대에 울려 퍼지는 당당한 PX 복귀 보고
00:54 19:30 싸지방(PC방)에서 '힘든 군생활' 허세글 쓰기
00:59 20:30 청소 시간만 되면 찾아오는 기적의 복통
01:07 22:00 연등 취소에 당직사관과 맞짱 뜨기(?)
01:17 엔딩: 내일이 더 기대되는 고문관의 하루
